selection: Fixed existing event windows plus June background window; no selection by forecast performance. Retrospective, not blinded.
boundaries: Lower inclusive, upper exclusive; positive leads only. Every issuance inside event window, every valid time inside event window. End exclusive.
pairing: Exact UTC timestamps, approved unqualified USGS discharge; no interpolation. Persistence uses latest eligible observation at/before issuance, maximum age 60 minutes.
coverage: Expected hourly slots per issue/bin clipped to event end. Report full horizon separately; missing slots never zero. Scores are matched samples only, overlapping issues are not independent observations.
